note: How catalog previews are made (tools/catalog/render_templates.py). Change anything here and bump styleVersion: every preview is then re-rendered, because the cache key includes it.

base.prompt: beige seamless tube top + beige slip shorts
base.why: The reference avatar is first dressed in the neutral, general-rated foundation with her own clothes off, so each catalog garment is the only thing that reads in its preview.

framing.why: Share of her height each category is framed on, bottom to top: a pair of flats in a full-body frame was a few pixels.

colors.why: Each garment in its own colour, so the catalog is not one navy. A template matching a rule takes that colour; the rest take the category palette in order of template id, so the choice is fixed for every build.

profiles.why: A category listed here is previewed on its own avatar and base instead of the default ones. Underwear needs an avatar the operator has declared adult (assets/library/policy.json): Forge fits it on no other, and the preview is the same job a person would run.

base.why: A nude set under every piece, so a bra preview is never topless below and briefs never topless above.

layer.why: Underbust and belt pieces are layered over the nude base set rather than replacing it. The guêpière's geometry ends below the bust although its template describes balconette cups; the operator chose to keep that geometry as it is, and layering keeps the bralette under it so the preview shows no bare chest.

framing.why: Bottoms are framed on her hips, waist to upper thigh, the usual product crop for a brief: the piece fills the picture and the bra above it is out of frame. Belts and stockings are framed low enough to show the stocking tops.

colors.whyPalette: Every colour reads against the nude base set and her skin: ivory, champagne, white and blush did not, and a balconette in ivory was nearly invisible.

limitations: under-guepiere-v1: the generated guêpière ends below the bust, while its template describes balconette cups and declares chest coverage. Kept as is by the operator's decision; the preview styles it with a matching bralette fitted on top.

styling.why: The Valentine's capsule (templates whose id has vday) is shown in the fabric it is sold in: lace for bras and briefs, satin for one-pieces. Words the planner reads (FABRICS); no texture is added that Forge does not build.

finish.why: The guêpière's template declares chest coverage, so Forge hides what is under her chest and the nude bralette under it disappears; its geometry ends below the bust and is kept exactly as it is (operator's decision). The preview adds a bralette in the same colour on top, as a coordinated set, after the guêpière is fitted. The build report names it (styledWith).

withheld.why: Templates whose fitted preview does not meet the catalogue's look, held back until the garment is improved. The template stays in the catalogue (underwear-inventory.json); only its picture is not published, and the build report says why.

presentation.why: PR1. Fitting and presentation are separate: every piece is still fitted over the nude base set (and the guêpière still styled with its bralette), but only the piece itself is drawn, on a neutral grey form, under studio light. The base set and her own clothes are hidden, not removed. garment-only adds the piece alone; a finishing piece adds a labelled styled view.
